title: H3157 (124th General Assembly): Pardons

provenance.fetched_by: LegiScan bulk data (gun-policy Stage 5, South Carolina); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official South Carolina text (Introduced, 2020-12-09; official copy, https://www.scstatehouse.gov/sess124_2021-2022/prever/3157_20201209.htm (LegiScan doc 2220175))
provenance.note: Introduced text, Dec. 9, 2020. No votes. Subsection (B) goes on to split the fee between Probation, Parole and Pardon Services and SLED.

operative_text:
Section 1 (new Section 24-21-925): (A) Notwithstanding another provision of law, a person who has been convicted of a felony offense, not described in Section 16-23-10(3) and who has completed his sentence, may make application to the board for a limited pardon that would allow him to possess a firearm for the purpose of hunting only.
Section 1 (new Section 24-21-925): (B) The application fee is two hundred dollars.
